title: A1
html: For each study, say whether the named factor is better treated as fixed or random, and what the corresponding target of inference is. (a) Four fertilizer formulations compared on a research farm. (b) Twenty operators sampled from a factory’s workforce, each measuring the same set of parts. (c) The two arms of a randomized trial. (d) Thirty schools sampled from a district, in a study of a teaching method. (e) Three furnaces, the only three the plant owns, in a study of their temperature uniformity.
